name: Dumbbell Burpee
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding flat-sided dumbbells at your sides.
Squat to plant both dumbbells firmly on the floor and hop or step your feet back into a plank.
Perform a push-up with your body straight, then hop or step your feet back toward the dumbbells.
Drive through your feet to stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides and repeat smoothly.
tips: Use stable flat-sided dumbbells and plant them solidly before shifting weight onto your hands.
Brace your core during the plank and push-up so your lower back does not sag.
